scope: Portable Windows desktop package on the development laptop. Windows UI Automation operates an isolated launcher and creator project.

creator.input: Windows UI Automation and an owned WM_CLOSE message

recovered_failures.cause: Refreshing the PowerShell process after exit lost its exit code.
recovered_failures.resolution: Retain its process handle and read the exit code before refreshing.

recovered_failures.cause: Closing during play let deferred Game view teardown read a stale desktop state and reset UI on a closing host.
recovered_failures.resolution: Refresh the native close state before detaching the Game view.

recovered_failures.cause: Codex thread/resume returned no rollout found for a newly opened conversation without a turn.
recovered_failures.resolution: Reconnect with a new conversation when the previous connection never submitted a turn.

limits: The installed Codex client was connected, disconnected and reconnected. The test submits no model turns.
Physical controls, fresh installation, gameplay compilation and export from the workspace are outside this check.
